title: Monsoon and Provision
author: Kestrel Quintana
blurb: Rafael Nystrom, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
